author: Seung Wook
problem: Read three integers a, b, c. Print Yes if b is the median of the three (it lies between a and c, inclusive), otherwise No.
bug_description: Checks whether b equals the integer average (a+c)//2 instead of whether b lies between a and c.

comments.accurate: Checks whether b lies between a and c
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks whether b sits at the midpoint of a and c, using integer division
comments.wrong_location: Middle-value test verified; check the input parsing for values on separate lines

source.fixed_line: if a <= b <= c or c <= b <= a:
